title: Data model for a Yeast2Value brewer's spent yeast batch
description: CIRCULOOS data model for a batch of brewer's spent yeast (BSY) collected from a brewery in the Yeast2Value value chain, covering its origin and collection, its storage conditions before pick-up, and the cell count and dry matter measurements taken on receipt.

value.description: Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

unitCode.description: Unit of measurement of the value, given as a UN/CEFACT code where one exists.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:circuloos-yeast2value:batch:<batchId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be YeastBatch

runId.description: Property. Dimensionless. Sequential run number of the sampling/analysis entry in the Yeast2Value yeast log.

batchId.description: Property. Laboratory code assigned to the yeast sample on receipt (e.g. PT_0149), used to trace the batch through analysis and processing.

brewery.description: Property. Name of the brewery (or source label) that supplied the brewer's spent yeast batch.

pickUpDate.description: Property. Date on which the spent yeast was collected from the brewery (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

storageDateBeforePickUp.description: Property. Date from which the yeast was stored at the brewery after harvesting, before collection (ISO 8601). Together with pickUpDate it gives the storage time before pick-up.

storageTemperatureBeforePickUp.description: Property. Expected unitCode: CEL. Temperature at which the yeast was kept at the brewery before collection. Breweries report either a single value or a bound or range, so use value for an exact figure and minValue/maxValue for a bound (e.g. "<4") or a range (e.g. "10 to 20").

phValueRawYeast.description: Property. Dimensionless. pH of the raw (untreated) spent yeast slurry, measured on receipt.

dryMassUnfiltered.description: Property. Expected unitCode: P1. Dry matter content of the unfiltered raw yeast slurry, in % (w/w). A key parameter for processing yield and transport efficiency.

volumetricFraction.description: Property. Expected unitCode: P1. Mass of the yeast pellet after centrifugation relative to the total sample mass, in %. Indicates how much solid yeast biomass the slurry contains.

totalCellCount.description: Property. Expected unitCode: cells/mL. Total number of yeast cells (living and dead) per millilitre of sample, determined by counting-chamber microscopy.

livingCellsCount.description: Property. Expected unitCode: cells/mL. Number of viable (living) yeast cells per millilitre of sample.

livingCellsPercent.description: Property. Expected unitCode: P1. Viability of the batch: living cells as a percentage of the total cell count (livingCellsCount / totalCellCount x 100).

feedstockSource.description: Property. Type of feedstock the batch represents; in Yeast2Value this is brewer's spent yeast (BSY), a by-product of beer fermentation.

valueChain.description: Property. Identifier of the CIRCULOOS value chain the record belongs to (here "yeast2value").

dataSource.description: Property. Name of the source file or dataset the record was taken from, for traceability.
